name: fullstack-integration
description: Tier 4 capstone: Build a unified full-stack application combining a shopping cart with backend API, real-time collaborative whiteboard, and an analytics dashboard with data visualization endpoints

milestones.name: E-commerce foundation
milestones.description: Create an Express server on port 3458 with a product catalog (6 seeded products across 3 categories), JWT-style auth (base64-encoded token), and a session-based shopping cart via X-Session-Id header. Implement: GET /health, GET /products, GET /products/:id, POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login, GET /auth/me (Bearer token), POST /cart/items, GET /cart, PUT /cart/items/:productId, DELETE /cart/items/:productId. Export the Express app as 'app'.
learningObjectives: Seeded product data with multiple categories
Session-based shopping cart using X-Session-Id header
acceptanceCriteria: Server listens on port 3458
GET /health returns 200 {status:'ok'}
GET /products returns array of 6 seeded products
Products have id, name, price, category, description, inStock fields
POST /auth/register returns {userId, email, name}, rejects duplicates with 409
POST /auth/login returns {token} for valid credentials, 401 for bad password
GET /auth/me with valid Bearer token returns user profile
POST /cart/items adds item (requires X-Session-Id), GET /cart returns items with subtotals and total

milestones.name: Checkout and inventory
milestones.description: Add stock tracking and order lifecycle. Each product gets a stockCount field (seed with values 0-50). POST /cart/items must reject out-of-stock products (stockCount === 0) with 400. POST /orders (authenticated) creates an order from the user's cart using X-Session-Id, clears the cart, decrements stock counts, and returns the order. GET /orders and GET /orders/:id for order history. First registered user is admin and can call PUT /admin/products/:id to update stockCount.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /products/:id includes stockCount field
POST /cart/items returns 400 for out-of-stock product (stockCount === 0)
POST /orders creates order with items, total, status='confirmed', createdAt
POST /orders clears the cart after success
POST /orders decrements product stockCount
GET /orders returns authenticated user's order list
GET /orders/:id returns order detail, 404 for another user's order
Previous milestone tests still pass

milestones.name: WebSocket real-time layer
milestones.description: Upgrade the server to support WebSocket connections on the same port. Switch from exporting 'app' (Express) to exporting 'server' (http.Server with WS attached). When a client connects via WebSocket, it should send {type:'hello', clientId:'<string>'}. The server responds with {type:'welcome', clientId:'<string>'}. Maintain a live count of connected clients. Implement GET /ws/stats returning {connectedClients: number}. Remove disconnected clients from the count automatically.
learningObjectives: WebSocket server attached to existing HTTP server
Exporting http.Server (not Express app) for WS compatibility
Client registration on WS connect via hello/welcome handshake
HTTP stats endpoint reflecting WS state
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket connection succeeds at ws://localhost:3458
Server sends {type:'welcome', clientId} after client sends {type:'hello', clientId}
Multiple clients can connect simultaneously
GET /ws/stats returns {connectedClients: N} reflecting live count
Disconnected client is removed and count decrements
HTTP routes still work alongside WebSocket

milestones.name: Collaborative whiteboard
milestones.description: Add a multi-user collaborative whiteboard over WebSocket. Clients join a board with {type:'whiteboard/join', boardId:'<string>'}. Server acknowledges with {type:'whiteboard/joined', boardId}. Draw operations {type:'whiteboard/draw', boardId, operation:{tool, x, y, color, size}} are broadcast to all other members of that board (not the sender). A new member joining receives {type:'whiteboard/sync', boardId, operations:[...]} with all previous operations. {type:'whiteboard/clear', boardId} resets the board and broadcasts to all members. Implement GET /whiteboard/:boardId/history returning the operations array.
acceptanceCriteria: Client receives whiteboard/joined ack after sending whiteboard/join
Draw operation broadcast to other board members, not sender
Client outside the board does not receive draw events
New joiner receives whiteboard/sync with all prior operations
whiteboard/clear resets history and broadcasts to all members
GET /whiteboard/:boardId/history returns operations array
Two different boardIds operate independently

milestones.name: Analytics pipeline
milestones.description: Instrument the existing routes to track analytics events automatically. GET /products/:id increments a view count for that product. POST /cart/items increments a cartAdds counter. POST /orders increments purchase count and adds to totalRevenue. Track unique customers (distinct userIds who ordered). Implement: GET /analytics/summary returning {totalOrders, totalRevenue, uniqueCustomers, totalProductViews}. GET /analytics/products returning array of products with {productId, name, views, cartAdds, purchases} sorted by views descending. GET /analytics/revenue returning {daily:[{date, revenue, orderCount}]} for the last 7 calendar days.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /products/:id increments view count tracked in analytics
POST /cart/items increments cartAdds for that product
POST /orders increments purchases and adds to totalRevenue
GET /analytics/summary returns correct aggregates
GET /analytics/products returns products sorted by views descending with metrics
GET /analytics/revenue returns last 7 days with date, revenue, orderCount

milestones.name: Dashboard and integration
milestones.description: Build a unified dashboard that aggregates data from all subsystems. GET /dashboard returns {ecommerce:{totalOrders, totalRevenue, topProducts:[{id,name,purchases}]}, whiteboard:{activeSessions, totalOperations}, realtime:{connectedClients}}. GET /dashboard/activity returns an array of the last 20 cross-system events (orders placed, whiteboard draws, user logins) each with {type, timestamp, summary}. Add a WebSocket dashboard channel: clients send {type:'dashboard/subscribe'} and receive {type:'dashboard/update', data} whenever a new order is placed or a whiteboard operation occurs. Bind the dashboard updates to live system activity.
learningObjectives: Activity log across multiple event sources
WebSocket push notifications triggered by HTTP events
Real-time data pipeline (HTTP action → WS push)
acceptanceCriteria: GET /dashboard returns all three sections: ecommerce, whiteboard, realtime
ecommerce section has totalOrders, totalRevenue, topProducts array
whiteboard section has activeSessions and totalOperations
realtime section has connectedClients
GET /dashboard/activity returns array of last 20 cross-system events with type, timestamp, summary
WS dashboard/subscribe client receives dashboard/update push when a new order is placed
